unit: monthly percentage change in domestic-market industrial PPI; country series are total-industry national indices, not energy-sector prices

scenario.description: Hypothetical one-month procurement cost shock and margin bridge; weights and pass-through are user assumptions, not estimates.

limitations: National total-industry PPI does not measure company energy bills
Monthly rates must be compounded, not summed, for cumulative index changes
Energy and non-energy PPI components are not procurement cost indices
Cross-country differences cannot be causally attributed to energy
No forecast backtest, confidence intervals or causal identification
